headline: AZB & Partners, Trilegal act on Steamhouse India ₹414 crore IPO
sum: Steamhouse India Limited has raised ₹414 crore from an intial public offering comprising a fresh issue aggregating to ₹353 crore and an offer for sale by the Promoter Selling Shareholder aggregating to ₹61 crore. AZB & Partners advised…
detail: Steamhouse India Limited has raised ₹414 crore from an intial public offering comprising a fresh issue aggregating to ₹353 crore and an offer for sale by the Promoter Selling Shareholder aggregating to ₹61 crore. AZB & Partners advised Steamhouse India on this IPO, according to the DRHP. Trilegal advised Equirus Capital Limited, the book-running lead manager for this IPO. The transaction was led by Abhinav Maker (Partner), with support from Jayant Saxena (Senior Associate), Associates Ipsita Sahoo and Varda Saxena; and Trainee Associate Nupur.
